purpose: Teach: 倭/弌/丙/鉉/辺野古/住専/フジサンケイビジネスアイ/日本経済新聞社
target_vocab: フジサンケイビジネスアイ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、古代の倭、つまり倭国の歴史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, I see you wrote your paper on the history of ancient Wa — the historical studies of Wa state.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone with genuine interest. Slight pause before clarifying the term, like she's checking that she read the topic correctly. Steady, professorial cadence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、旧字「弌」、つまり一の用法研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, that's right. I studied the usage of the old character form for 'ichi' — the character for one.
lines.style: Quiet but clear. A small catch of breath before the clarification, uncertain whether he's correctly understood what she asked. Careful, methodical pacing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、武家の丙、つまり丙等級の制度研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on samurai systems — the ranking structures of the warrior class, if I'm remembering correctly.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective tone. The question-lilt at the end is genuine curiosity, not leading. She's giving him room to correct her. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、漢字の鉉、つまり鉉の鼎の取っ手の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the han character, specifically the handles of bronze tripod vessels in classical texts.
lines.style: Brief, precise. A small steadying breath. He's clarifying what sounds like a specific detail, almost apologetic about the correction but certain of his ground.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、辺野古の基地問題の社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, I thought your research was on the Henoko base issue — the sociological angle on that controversy.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause. She's genuinely uncertain now, testing her memory. Warm but giving him plenty of space to correct her gently. Slower, more deliberate.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、住専、つまり住宅専門金融の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I was researching jusen — the housing finance institutions and their role in the economy.
lines.style: Calm and clear. A brief breath before the clarification, settling into his actual topic with quiet confidence. Matter-of-fact, not defensive.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、フジサンケイビジネスアイのアーカイブ研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, I believed your paper was on archival research using the Fuji Sankei Business i materials.
lines.style: Slower, more hesitant now — she's aware she might be misremembering. Warm, not at all sharp. Genuine apology in her tone for possibly getting it wrong again.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、日本経済新聞社のデータベース活用研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Right — but I was actually examining how to use the Nikkei newspaper database effectively in research.
lines.style: Final clarification with quiet completion. Small exhale of relief that the exchange is closing. Calm, assured tone. Settles naturally, not defensive.
